additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
Mr.Marcel from IFTEC raised a ticket regarding a CanCommLoss converter. Please check if the CAN cables are not loose and are properly attached.
Next step is to swap this converter with a working one. After swapping if the error persists in this same converter then please replace it. If the error is now on the working converter we need to replace the CAN cables.
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0411974 ﻿from the
